profile.name: Dr. Arvind Kumar Jha
profile.title: Associate Professor
profile.bio: Associate Professor at IIT Patna specializing in Civil & Environmental Engineering. Passionate about research, teaching, and solving real-world infrastructure challenges.
profile.affiliation: IIT Patna, Department of Civil & Environmental Engineering

focusAreas.title: Genomics & ML
focusAreas.desc: Applying machine learning models to large-scale genomic datasets to uncover hidden biological patterns and disease mechanisms.

focusAreas.title: Computational Biology
focusAreas.desc: Building algorithmic frameworks to simulate, analyze, and predict biological processes at the molecular and cellular scale.
